rockchip: Don't wait for params buf when it not ready The params buf might not be ready to dequeue when output buf done. Waiting for it would affect the performance, and it's unnecessary since the params would actually take effect on the next frame. Open v4l2 dev in nonblock mode, and stop trying when dqbuf returns EAGAIN to avoid the waiting. __init__: Speed up importing process in chromite programs. In merged CL:456757, it used pkg_resources to create a namespace module for google and google.protobuf to prevents out-of-date global packages from shadowing the third_party packages. But pkg_resources is a huge python module and loading it takes around 0.2s, this CL changes the timing of doing above work so that pkg_resources will be imported only if google.protobuf is imported. Therefore, the python programs under chromite/ won't have to waste 0.2s if they don't require google.protobuf.
